object: cc_duct_peaking_pct takes the duct-burner peaking share as the WHOLE plant's nameplate-minus-net-summer gap whenever ANY generator row is flagged Duct Burners = Y; the CT rows in that sum are flagged X (no duct burner) by the same filing, so their ambient derate is booked as duct capability and priced at the 2.25x peak band.

F0_construction.note: the Duct Burners attribute is reported only on CA/CS (steam) rows; every CT row in the operable population reads X (not applicable), so a CT row's nameplate-vs-summer gap cannot be duct capability
